prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1033; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision at the intersection in Baytown, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. A vehicle coming from my right did not stop for its red light and hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw something move out of the corner of my eye, but there was no time to react. It happened very fast.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Where did you feel the impact, and how did your body move?

A: The impact was on my side, so the car spun a little and my body pushed against the door. My right knee hit the dashboard area and then the door frame.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle right away?

A: I got out with some help. My knee was hurting badly and I couldn't put much weight on it.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that same day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist for my knee.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment for the knee?

A: Yes, I have physical therapy twice a week and I'm still using a brace when I walk for long periods.

Q: Before this accident, did you have any problems with that same knee?

A: No, not that I can recall. It had been fine.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident or your injuries?

A: I just want to get my car repaired and my knee back to normal. I'm willing to provide any medical records you need.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.

A: Thank you.
